mapper.select: SELECT a.article_code, a.folder_code, f.title AS folder_title, a.title, a.content_md, a.status, a.published_at, a.created_at, a.updated_at FROM cms_article a LEFT JOIN cms_folder f ON f.folder_code = a.folder_code AND f.del_flag = false WHERE a.article_code = #{articleCode} AND a.del_flag = false LIMIT 1

SELECT a.article_code, a.folder_code, f.title AS folder_title, a.title, a.content_md, a.status, a.published_at, a.created_at, a.updated_at FROM cms_article a LEFT JOIN cms_folder f ON f.folder_code = a.folder_code AND f.del_flag = false WHERE a.folder_code = #{folderCode} AND a.del_flag = false
AND a.status = 'PUBLISHED'
ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC

SELECT a.article_code, a.folder_code, f.title AS folder_title, a.title, a.content_md, a.status, a.published_at, a.created_at, a.updated_at FROM cms_article a LEFT JOIN cms_folder f ON f.folder_code = a.folder_code AND f.del_flag = false WHERE a.del_flag = false
AND (a.title ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.content_md ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND a.status = 'PUBLISHED'
ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cms_article WHERE folder_code = #{folderCode} AND del_flag = false
mapper.update: UPDATE cms_article SET del_flag = true, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = 'system' WHERE article_code = #{articleCode} AND del_flag = false
